summary: One configuration safety check is missing: the new world health alarm wiring can silently mis-dimension alarms when alerts are enabled but ALB ARN suffix is not provided.

issues.description: When alerts are enabled (alerts_topic_arn set) but alb_arn_suffix is left empty, the HealthyHostCount alarm will be created with an invalid/missing LoadBalancer dimension. This results in a perpetually breaching alarm on missing data or a silent no-op alarm, depending on treat_missing_data. Add validation to prevent misconfiguration.
issues.current_code:
```hcl
variable "alb_arn_suffix" {
  description = "arn_suffix of the shared ALB (required for HealthyHostCount alarm dimensions when alerts_topic_arn is set)"
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}
```
issues.explanation: This prevents creating mis-dimensioned alarms whenever alerts are enabled. It preserves backward compatibility (alerts_topic_arn empty) while enforcing the required ALB suffix when alarms are actually created.
